name: CloakBrowser
description: Stealth Chromium browser with 58 source-level C++ fingerprint patches. Runs as a CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) server with Xvfb headed mode for maximum stealth. Passes Cloudflare Turnstile, reCAPTCHA v3 (0.9 score), FingerprintJS, BrowserScan and 30+ detection sites. Per-connection fingerprint seeds allow multiple browser identities from a single container. Connect via Playwright API (Python/Node.js). Note: do not use Puppeteer to connect as it leaks detectable automation signals. WARNING: CDP gives full browser control - never expose port 9222 to the internet without authentication. ~190MB RAM idle, ~30MB per additional tab. Binary is free to use but not redistributable.

paths.name: Browser Cache
paths.description: CloakBrowser binary and profile cache directory. First run downloads ~200MB Chromium binary.

paths.name: Persistent Profile
paths.description: Browser profile data (cookies, localStorage, etc). Mount for persistent sessions across restarts.

ports.name: CDP Port
ports.description: Chrome DevTools Protocol port. Connect via ws:// :9222. SECURITY: Do not expose to the internet without additional authentication.

variables.name: GPU Acceleration
variables.description: GPU for hardware-accelerated rendering. 'intel' = passthrough /dev/dri (iGPU, default). 'nvidia' = use NVIDIA GPU (change Extra Parameters to: --shm-size=2g --gpus all --runtime=nvidia, and remove --device=/dev/dri:/dev/dri). 'none' = software rendering only (remove --device=/dev/dri:/dev/dri from Extra Parameters).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Enable automatic background update checks for the stealth Chromium binary.

variables.name: Idle Timeout
variables.description: Seconds before idle browser processes are reaped. Prevents resource exhaustion from too many Chrome instances.

variables.name: Proxy Server
variables.description: HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy for browser connections (e.g. http://user:pass@proxy:8080 or socks5://proxy:1080).

variables.name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
variables.description: Only for NVIDIA GPU mode. Set to 'all' or specific GPU ID (0, 1, etc). Leave empty if using Intel iGPU.

variables.name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
variables.description: Only for NVIDIA GPU mode. Driver capabilities to expose.

variables.name: Binary Path Override
variables.description: Skip download - use a custom local Chromium binary path inside the container.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Download server for the stealth Chromium binary. Must include https:// prefix.

variables.name: Skip Checksum
variables.description: Skip SHA-256 verification of downloaded binary. Not recommended.
